work.description: Reference to the parent work-submission record.

title.description: This edition's own title (usually matches the work's title, but may differ for a retitled or translated edition).

coverUri.description: Optional URL to a cover image for this specific edition, hosted by the submitter. Runtime validation MUST restrict this to https:// URLs.

language.description: Optional ISO 639-1 or BCP 47 language code for this edition.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with trailing Z when this record was created.

pageCount.description: Optional number of pages in this edition. Not populated when editionFormat is audiobook; see durationSeconds.

sourceUri.description: Optional URL to this edition's page on the submitter's own site.

updatedAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with trailing Z when this record was last updated by republishing.

derivedFrom.description: Optional reference to the record this submission's data was derived from. Carries no meaning to Dracome's ingestion; exists for downstream consumers to walk provenance.

description.description: Optional free-text description specific to this edition, if different from the work's.

editionName.description: Optional label for a specific print or release (e.g., 'First Edition', 'Hardcover').

identifiers.description: Optional external identifiers (edition-specific ISBN, etc.), plus the submitter's proprietary identifier.

seriesTitle.description: Optional series this edition belongs to.

editionFormat.description: Optional physical or media format (paperback, hardcover, ebook, audiobook, board_book, spiral_bound, library_binding, pamphlet).

publisherName.description: Optional name of this edition's publisher.

seriesPosition.description: Optional position within the series (e.g., '3' or '3.5').

durationSeconds.description: Optional total duration in seconds for audiobook editions. Only populated when editionFormat is audiobook; pageCount and durationSeconds are never both set on the same edition.

publicationDate.description: Optional this edition's publication date, at whatever precision is known.

main.description: A submission record carrying candidate catalog data for an edition of a previously-submitted work, published by a trusted submitter to their own PDS. Repeatable; a submitter may create, update, or delete edition-submission records over time.

cid.description: Optional content hash of the work record at time of reference; informational only.

uri.description: AT-URI of the owning social.dracome.catalog.submission.work record.

workSubmissionRef.description: A reference to the parent work-submission record.
